segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ חוּלְיַת הַבּוֹר וְהַסֶּלַע שֶׁהֵן גְּבוֹהִין עֲשָׂרָה וְרׇחְבָּן אַרְבָּעָה, הַנּוֹטֵל מֵהֶן וְהַנּוֹתֵן עַל גַּבָּן — חַיָּיב, פָּחוֹת מִכֵּן — פָּטוּר.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» With regard to «the bank» surrounding «a pit and the boulder that are ten» handbreadths «high and four» handbreadths «wide, one who takes» an object from «them» to the public domain «and» similarly «one who places» an object from the public domain «atop them is liable» for carrying from one domain to another. If the height or width of the pit or the boulder is «less than that» height, ten handbreadths, «one is exempt» because the legal status of those protrusions is not distinct from that of the surrounding public domain.

moves.summary: ten high and four wide is its own domain; less is exempt

positions.claim: taking from or placing on a pit bank or boulder ten high and four wide is liable; less is exempt

principlesInvoked: רשות היחיד גבוה עשרה ורחב ארבעה
